info.title: Daycry Auth browser and JSON forms
info.description: Session-cookie authentication. Send Accept: application/json and a JSON or form body. Mutations require the application CSRF header/token. HTML clients retain redirects. Route prefixes are application-configurable.

200.description: JSON result. Token is the current CSRF name and hash.

400.description: Malformed JSON or request body must be an object

401.description: Invalid credentials, token or missing authenticated session

403.description: Feature disabled or CSRF verification failed

202.description: Post-authentication action required; authenticated is false; redirect points to the action.
